title: Applying for a Job
goal: Prepare short application text from supplied facts, follow a stated submission request, and explain an application problem.

runs.text: A
resume
summarizes relevant experience, education and skills. A
cover letter
connects your background to a particular position. An
application form
asks for information in the employer's chosen format. A
deadline
is the stated latest time for submission.
References
are people an employer may ask about your experience or work; they are not the same as contact details for yourself.
Use the document name requested by the employer. An application may request a CV or other materials instead of, or alongside, a resume. Ask if the requirement is unclear:
Which documents should I submit?

blocks.caption: Preparing and discussing materials · Applicant & Friend

runs.text: Look over
means review.
Update
means make the information current.
Proofread
means check for errors in the wording or text.
Could you check whether this is clear?
makes a useful request without asking someone to invent experience for you.
The following role is invented for practice:

paragraphs.text: Café assistant, June 2025–June 2026. Took customer orders, answered menu questions and organized supplies.
Customer communication, order accuracy and teamwork.

runs.text: Experience
says what the person did. A skill label such as
teamwork
becomes clearer when linked to an actual example. This is a short extract to discuss and revise, not a required resume format.
For the same role, Sam enjoys books, wants to help bookstore customers, and can start November 1. A short original letter connects those facts to the position:

paragraphs.text:
Dear Hiring Manager,
I'm applying for the store-assistant position. During a year working in a café, I took orders, answered customers' questions and organized supplies. I also completed a business certificate. I'd like to bring that customer-service experience to your bookstore because I enjoy books and helping people find what they need. I'm available afternoons and weekends and could start November 1. Thank you for considering my application.
Sam Rivera

runs.text: The letter identifies the position, relevant experience, interest and availability. Use the facts you have;
helping customers
does not require inventing sales figures or management experience.
For this fictional application: submit a resume and a short cover letter through the employer's form by 5 p.m. October 20. The form requests PDF files and a contact email address.

turns.speaker: Applicant

runs.text: The form asks for a resume and cover letter as PDFs. Is five o'clock the deadline?

turns.en: The form asks for a resume and cover letter as PDFs. Is five o'clock the deadline?

runs.text: Yes, on October twentieth.

turns.speaker: Applicant

runs.text: Thanks. The upload failed when I tried to send the cover letter. What should I do?

turns.en: Thanks. The upload failed when I tried to send the cover letter. What should I do?

turns.speaker: Contact

runs.text: Tell us the error message so we can explain the submission options.

turns.en: Tell us the error message so we can explain the submission options.

turns.speaker: Applicant

turns.en: It says the file is too large. Is there another way to submit it?

blocks.caption: Read the actual request · Applicant & Contact

runs.text: Upload
sends a file to an online system.
Submit
sends an application for consideration.
Save a draft
keeps an unfinished version. A successful upload is not automatically confirmation that the whole application was submitted:
How can I confirm you received the application?
asks about that final result.
Useful questions are
What does this field mean?
Do you need the full address?
Should I list my most recent job first?
, and
Is this section required?
A
required field
must be completed under the form's instructions. If something does not apply or you are unsure what to enter, ask rather than making up a fact.

turns.speaker: Applicant

runs.text: This asks for my earliest start date. Does that mean when I could begin work?

turns.en: This asks for my earliest start date. Does that mean when I could begin work?

runs.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: Applicant

runs.text: I could start November first. I'll enter that.

turns.en: I could start November first. I'll enter that.

blocks.caption: Form questions and support · Applicant & Contact

runs.text: Speak both roles alone using the contact's responses. Write the short revision and letter from the supplied role facts; no real application is submitted.
Use the fictional request to state the documents, format and deadline. Ask one confirmation question.
Revise Sam's skills section by adding a concrete example from the experience given. Do not add an achievement absent from the role facts.
Your upload says
file too large
. Report the exact problem and ask for an alternative submission option.
Ask what
earliest start date
means, then give November 1 as your role's available date.

Write a three-sentence cover-letter body for Sam: identify the job, connect one experience to the role, and state availability. Use the model for support, then check the facts against the resume extract.
Sample possibilities:

“I need a resume and cover letter as PDFs by five on October twentieth. How can I confirm receipt?” / “Customer communication: answered customers' menu questions.” / “The upload failed. It says the file is too large. Is there another way to submit it?”
Possible letter body:

“I'm applying for the store-assistant position. I have a year of café experience answering customers' questions, and I'd like to use those skills in your bookstore. I'm available afternoons and weekends and could start November 1.”
Later, change the stated requirements and read them before responding. Check that the application facts are accurate, the requested documents are identified, and any problem is described clearly.
